title: UN Commission finding on incitement to genocide by Israeli officials
summary: The Commission assessed statements by senior Israeli political officials as part of its Genocide Convention legal analysis.
claim: The Commission concluded that President Isaac Herzog, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and then Defence Minister Yoav Gallant had incited the commission of genocide and that Israeli authorities failed to take action to punish the incitement.
legal_characterization: Incitement-to-genocide finding by a UN commission of inquiry; not a criminal conviction or judicial judgment against the named individuals.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Legal analysis of the conduct of Israel in Gaza pursuant to the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide
verification_notes: Verified against paragraph 253 of A/HRC/60/CRP.3. The named-person characterization is explicitly a UN Commission finding; the record does not present it as an ICC or domestic criminal conviction or as an ICJ judgment.
